sources.title: Granite 4.2 30B: IBM's Apache-2.0 Reasoning Model | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: Granite 4.2 30B is IBM's Apache-2.0 dense reasoning model, released 25 Aug 2026 with a switchable thinking mode, 128K context and 57.0 on SWE-bench Verified.

sources.title: Granite 4.2 brings native reasoning to enterprise agents
sources.snippet: IBM's new open Granite models are designed for agentic AI, combining reasoning, tool use, coding, instruction following, and speech capabilities. Read a full technical breakdown of how the Granite 4.2 LLMs were built on Hugging Face.
